Public Shared Function GuessPositiveClass(explicitText As String, rowCount As Func(Of Integer),
                                                   text As Func(Of Integer, String), binary As Func(Of Integer, Boolean),
                                                   ByRef positiveLabel As String) As Boolean
            positiveLabel = Nothing
            If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(explicitText) Then
                positiveLabel = explicitText
                Return True
            End If
            Dim distinctTokens As New List(Of String)()
            Dim distinctNormalized As New HashSet(Of String)(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            Dim allBinary01 As Boolean = True
            For i As Integer = 0 To rowCount() - 1
                Dim token As String = text(i)
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(token) Then Continue For
                If Not binary(i) Then allBinary01 = False
                Dim normalized As String = UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)
                If Not distinctNormalized.Contains(normalized) Then
                    distinctNormalized.Add(normalized)
                    distinctTokens.Add(token)
                End If
            Next
            If allBinary01 Then
                positiveLabel = "1"
                Return True
            End If
            If distinctTokens.Count = 2 Then
                Dim norms As String() = distinctTokens.Select(Function(token) UdfDataImportOptions38.NormalizeOptionKey(token)).ToArray()
                For i As Integer = 0 To norms.Length - 1
                    Select Case LegacyUdfText38.CaseToken(norms(i), {"positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"})
                        Case "positive", "pos", "case", "cases", "event", "events", "yes", "true"
                            positiveLabel = distinctTokens(i)
                            Return True
                    End Select
                Next
                positiveLabel = distinctTokens(0)
                Return True
            End If
            Return False
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function TryGetStringVectorPrepared(arr As Object(,), convertCell As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef values() As String) As Boolean

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function TryGetStringVectorPrepared(arr As Object(,), convertCell As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef values() As String) As Boolean
            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            Dim list As New List(Of String)()
            If rows = 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    list.Add(convertCell(arr(0, j)))
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    list.Add(convertCell(arr(i, 0)))
                Next
            Else
                Return False
            End If

            values = list.ToArray()
            Return values.Length > 0
        End Function

            Dim rows As Integer = arr.GetLength(0)
            Dim cols As Integer = arr.GetLength(1)
            Dim vals As New List(Of Double)()
            If rows = 1 Then
                For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                    Dim d As Double? = convertCell(arr(0, j))
                    If Not d.HasValue Then Return False
                    vals.Add(d.Value)
                Next
            ElseIf cols = 1 Then
                For i As Integer = 0 To rows - 1
                    Dim d As Double? = convertCell(arr(i, 0))
                    If Not d.HasValue Then Return False
                    vals.Add(d.Value)
                Next
            Else
                Return False
            End If

            values = vals.ToArray()
            Return values.Length > 0
        End Function

source_record.name: CompleteRocInputPrepared
source_record.signature: Public Shared Function CompleteRocInputPrepared(markerCol As Object(,), statusCol As Object(,), positiveLabel As String, isLowerDirection As Boolean, finiteDouble As UdfPlotFiniteDoubleReader38, status01 As UdfPlotStatusReader38, toText As Func(Of Object, String), normalize As Func(Of String, String), ByRef rocInput()() As Double) As Boolean

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function CompleteRocInputPrepared(markerCol As Object(,), statusCol As Object(,), positiveLabel As String, isLowerDirection As Boolean, finiteDouble As UdfPlotFiniteDoubleReader38, status01 As UdfPlotStatusReader38, toText As Func(Of Object, String), normalize As Func(Of String, String), ByRef rocInput()() As Double) As Boolean
            Dim pos As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim neg As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim normalizedPositive As String = normalize(positiveLabel)

            For i As Integer = 0 To markerCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim x As Double
                If Not finiteDouble(markerCol(i, 0), x) Then Continue For

                Dim label As String = toText(statusCol(i, 0))
                If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(label) Then Continue For

                Dim isPositive As Boolean = False
                Dim iv As Integer
                If normalizedPositive = "1" AndAlso status01(statusCol(i, 0), iv) Then
                    isPositive = (iv = 1)
                Else
                    isPositive = String.Equals(normalize(label), normalizedPositive, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                End If

                If isLowerDirection Then x = -x
                If isPositive Then
                    pos.Add(x)
                Else
                    neg.Add(x)
                End If
            Next

            If pos.Count < 1 OrElse neg.Count < 1 Then Return False
            rocInput = New Double()() {pos.ToArray(), neg.ToArray()}
            Return True
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function CompleteSurvivalRecordsPrepared(timeCol As Object(,), statusCol As Object(,), groupCol As Object(,), hasGroup As Boolean, finiteDouble As UdfPlotFiniteDoubleReader38, status01 As UdfPlotStatusReader38, toText As Func(Of Object, String), ByRef records As List(Of survival.SurvivalRecord)) As Boolean
            Dim tList As New List(Of Double)()
            Dim sList As New List(Of Integer)()
            Dim gList As New List(Of String)()
            Dim stratList As New List(Of String)()

            For i As Integer = 0 To timeCol.GetLength(0) - 1
                Dim t As Double
                Dim s As Integer
                If Not finiteDouble(timeCol(i, 0), t) Then Continue For
                If t < 0.0R Then Return False
                If Not status01(statusCol(i, 0), s) Then Continue For

                Dim g As String = "ALL"
                If hasGroup Then
                    g = toText(groupCol(i, 0))
                    If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(g) Then Continue For
                End If

                tList.Add(t)
                sList.Add(s)
                gList.Add(g)
                stratList.Add("ALL")
            Next

            If tList.Count < 1 Then Return False

            Dim err As String = Nothing
            records = survival.Survival.CreatSurvivalData(tList.ToArray(), sList.ToArray(), gList.ToArray(), stratList.ToArray(), err)
            Return records IsNot Nothing AndAlso records.Count > 0
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildCalibrationPointsTable(rows As IList(Of Global.BESHStatNG.regression.CalibrationBinSummary), missingIntervalValue As Double) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim out(rows.Count, 7) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Bin"
            out(0, 1) = "N"
            out(0, 2) = "MeanPredicted"
            out(0, 3) = "ObservedRate"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "ErrorMinus"
            out(0, 7) = "ErrorPlus"

            For i As Integer = 0 To rows.Count - 1
                Dim r = rows(i)
                out(i + 1, 0) = r.BinIndex
                out(i + 1, 1) = r.N
                out(i + 1, 2) = r.MeanPredicted
                out(i + 1, 3) = r.ObservedRate
                out(i + 1, 4) = r.LowerCI
                out(i + 1, 5) = r.UpperCI
                out(i + 1, 6) = If(Double.IsNaN(r.LowerCI), missingIntervalValue, r.ObservedRate - r.LowerCI)
                out(i + 1, 7) = If(Double.IsNaN(r.UpperCI), missingIntervalValue, r.UpperCI - r.ObservedRate)
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildRocPointsTable(cutoffTable As Object(,), isLowerDirection As Boolean, tryFinite As UdfModelProfilePreparation38.FiniteDoubleReader) As Object(,)
            If cutoffTable Is Nothing OrElse cutoffTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC cut-off table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim n As Integer = cutoffTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(n + 2, 4) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Threshold"
            out(0, 1) = "Sensitivity"
            out(0, 2) = "Specificity"
            out(0, 3) = "FalsePositiveRate"
            out(0, 4) = "TruePositiveRate"

            out(1, 0) = ""
            out(1, 1) = 1.0R
            out(1, 2) = 0.0R
            out(1, 3) = 1.0R
            out(1, 4) = 1.0R

            For i As Integer = 1 To n
                Dim thresholdObj As Object = cutoffTable(i, 0)
                Dim threshold As Double
                If tryFinite(thresholdObj, threshold) Then
                    out(i + 1, 0) = If(isLowerDirection, -threshold, threshold)
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 0) = thresholdObj
                End If

                Dim sens As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 1), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Dim spec As Double = Convert.ToDouble(cutoffTable(i, 2), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                out(i + 1, 1) = sens
                out(i + 1, 2) = spec
                out(i + 1, 3) = 1.0R - spec
                out(i + 1, 4) = sens
            Next

            out(n + 2, 0) = ""
            out(n + 2, 1) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 2) = 1.0R
            out(n + 2, 3) = 0.0R
            out(n + 2, 4) = 0.0R
            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildRocStatsTable(summaryTable As Object(,)) As Object(,)
            If summaryTable Is Nothing OrElse summaryTable.GetLength(0) < 2 Then
                Return UdfOutputTablesReports38.BuildSimpleNoteTable("ROC", "No ROC summary table was returned.").ToOutputModel().Values
            End If

            Dim bodyRows As Integer = summaryTable.GetLength(0) - 1
            Dim out(bodyRows, 1) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Metric"
            out(0, 1) = "Value"
            For i As Integer = 1 To bodyRows
                out(i, 0) = summaryTable(i, 0)
                out(i, 1) = summaryTable(i, 1)
            Next
            Return out
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildHistogramPartsPrepared(groups()() As Double, names() As String, resolvedRule As String, computeBins As Func(Of Double(), String, Object(,))) As List(Of Object(,))
            Dim parts As New List(Of Object(,))()

            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                Dim values() As Double = groups(i)
                If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim bins As Object(,) = computeBins(values, resolvedRule)
                If bins Is Nothing OrElse bins.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim part(bins.GetLength(0), 2) As Object
                part(0, 0) = "Group"
                part(0, 1) = "BinMidpoint"
                part(0, 2) = "Frequency"
                For r As Integer = 0 To bins.GetLength(0) - 1
                    part(r + 1, 0) = names(i)
                    part(r + 1, 1) = bins(r, 0)
                    part(r + 1, 2) = bins(r, 1)
                Next
                parts.Add(part)
            Next

            Return parts
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildHistogramNormalPartsPrepared(groups()() As Double, names() As String, resolvedRule As String, computeBins As Func(Of Double(), String, Object(,)), computeOverlay As Func(Of Double(), Double(), Double(,))) As List(Of Object(,))
            Dim parts As New List(Of Object(,))()

            For i As Integer = 0 To groups.Length - 1
                Dim values() As Double = groups(i)
                If values Is Nothing OrElse values.Length < 2 Then Continue For

                Dim bins As Object(,) = computeBins(values, resolvedRule)
                If bins Is Nothing OrElse bins.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim mids(bins.GetLength(0) - 1) As Double
                For r As Integer = 0 To bins.GetLength(0) - 1
                    mids(r) = Convert.ToDouble(bins(r, 0), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                Next

                Dim overlay As Double(,) = computeOverlay(values, mids)
                If overlay Is Nothing OrElse overlay.GetLength(0) < 1 Then Continue For

                Dim part(overlay.GetLength(0), 2) As Object
                part(0, 0) = "Group"
                part(0, 1) = "X"
                part(0, 2) = "NormalFrequency"
                For r As Integer = 0 To overlay.GetLength(0) - 1
                    part(r + 1, 0) = names(i)
                    part(r + 1, 1) = overlay(r, 0)
                    part(r + 1, 2) = overlay(r, 1)
                Next
                parts.Add(part)
            Next

            Return parts
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildKaplanMeierStepTablePrepared(rawCurves As Object(), countRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), fillRecord As Func(Of Object, survival.SurvivalTableRecord), noteTable As Func(Of String, String, Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1 'header

            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(countRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For
                totalRows += 1 + 2 * recs.Count
            Next

            If totalRows <= 1 Then
                Return noteTable("Kaplan-Meier", "No survival-curve rows were returned.")
            End If

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, 6) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            out(0, 1) = "PlotOrder"
            out(0, 2) = "Time"
            out(0, 3) = "Survival"
            out(0, 4) = "LowerCI"
            out(0, 5) = "UpperCI"
            out(0, 6) = "AtRisk"

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each groupObj As Object In rawCurves
                If groupObj Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim items As IEnumerable = TryCast(groupObj, IEnumerable)
                If items Is Nothing Then Continue For
                Dim recs As List(Of survival.SurvivalTableRecord) = items.Cast(Of Object)().Select(fillRecord).ToList()
                If recs.Count = 0 Then Continue For

                Dim groupName As String = recs(0).strGroup
                Dim prevProb As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevLL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim prevUL As Double = 1.0R
                Dim plotOrder As Integer = 1

                out(row, 0) = groupName
                out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                out(row, 2) = 0.0R
                out(row, 3) = 1.0R
                out(row, 4) = 1.0R
                out(row, 5) = 1.0R
                out(row, 6) = recs(0).AtRisk
                row += 1
                plotOrder += 1

                For Each rec As survival.SurvivalTableRecord In recs
                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = prevProb
                    out(row, 4) = prevLL
                    out(row, 5) = prevUL
                    out(row, 6) = ""
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    out(row, 0) = groupName
                    out(row, 1) = plotOrder
                    out(row, 2) = rec.Time
                    out(row, 3) = rec.Prob
                    out(row, 4) = rec.ProbCILL
                    out(row, 5) = rec.ProbCIUL
                    out(row, 6) = rec.AtRisk
                    row += 1
                    plotOrder += 1

                    prevProb = rec.Prob
                    prevLL = rec.ProbCILL
                    prevUL = rec.ProbCIUL
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function StackHomogeneousTablesPrepared(tables As List(Of Object(,))) As Object(,)
            Dim cols As Integer = tables(0).GetLength(1)
            Dim totalRows As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                totalRows += Math.Max(0, tbl.GetLength(0) - 1)
            Next

            Dim out(totalRows - 1, cols - 1) As Object
            For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                out(0, j) = tables(0)(0, j)
            Next

            Dim row As Integer = 1
            For Each tbl As Object(,) In tables
                For i As Integer = 1 To tbl.GetLength(0) - 1
                    For j As Integer = 0 To cols - 1
                        out(row, j) = tbl(i, j)
                    Next
                    row += 1
                Next
            Next

            Return out
        End Function

Public Shared Function BuildClusterPreprocessingTable(varNames() As String, locations() As Double, scales() As Double,
                                                        mode As Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode) As UdfReportProjection38
            Dim varCount As Integer = 0
            If varNames IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = varNames.Length
            ElseIf locations IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = locations.Length
            ElseIf scales IsNot Nothing Then
                varCount = scales.Length
            End If

            If mode = Multivariate.ClusterStandardizationMode.None OrElse varCount <= 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Standardization"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim out(varCount, 2) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Variable"
            out(0, 1) = "Location"
            out(0, 2) = "Scale"
            For i As Integer = 0 To varCount - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = If(varNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < varNames.Length, CType(varNames(i), Object), CType("X" & (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture), Object))
                out(i + 1, 1) = If(locations IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < locations.Length, CType(locations(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
                out(i + 1, 2) = If(scales IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < scales.Length, CType(scales(i), Object), CType(Nothing, Object))
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildRemovedRowsOutput(rowIds() As Integer, rowLabels() As String) As UdfReportProjection38
            If rowIds Is Nothing OrElse rowIds.Length = 0 Then
                Dim note(1, 1) As Object
                note(0, 0) = "Setting"
                note(0, 1) = "Value"
                note(1, 0) = "Removed rows"
                note(1, 1) = "None"
                Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(note), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
            End If

            Dim hasLabels As Boolean = (rowLabels IsNot Nothing AndAlso rowLabels.Length = rowIds.Length)
            Dim out(rowIds.Length, If(hasLabels, 2, 1)) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "OriginalRow"
            If hasLabels Then
                out(0, 1) = "RowLabel"
                out(0, 2) = "Reason"
            Else
                out(0, 1) = "Reason"
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To rowIds.Length - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = rowIds(i)
                If hasLabels Then
                    out(i + 1, 1) = rowLabels(i)
                    out(i + 1, 2) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                Else
                    out(i + 1, 1) = "Removed before fitting because at least one analysis variable was missing or non-finite."
                End If
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

source_record.signature: Public Shared Function BuildDiscriminantMeansTable(model As Multivariate.DiscriminantAnalysis, useOriginalScale As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38

contracts.whole_body:
Public Shared Function BuildDiscriminantMeansTable(model As Multivariate.DiscriminantAnalysis,
                                                     useOriginalScale As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If model Is Nothing OrElse model.GroupStatistics Is Nothing Then Return Nothing
            Dim g As Integer = model.GroupStatistics.Count
            If g < 1 Then Return Nothing
            Dim p As Integer = model.GroupStatistics(0).MeanOriginal.Length
            Dim out(g, p) As Object
            out(0, 0) = "Group"
            For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                out(0, j + 1) = model.PreparedData.VariableNames(j)
            Next
            For i As Integer = 0 To g - 1
                out(i + 1, 0) = model.GroupStatistics(i).GroupLabel
                Dim values() As Double = If(useOriginalScale, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanOriginal, model.GroupStatistics(i).MeanWorking)
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(i + 1, j + 1) = values(j)
                Next
            Next
            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.Raw)
        End Function

Public Shared Function FindWrappedDiscriminantTablePrepared(tables As IEnumerable(Of ResultTable), title As String, startsWith As Boolean, toText As Func(Of Object, String)) As Object(,)
            For Each t As ResultTable In tables
                Dim arr As Object(,) = t.returnSelf()
                If arr Is Nothing OrElse arr.GetLength(0) < 1 OrElse arr.GetLength(1) < 1 Then Continue For
                Dim candidate As String = toText(arr(0, 0))
                If startsWith Then
                    If candidate.StartsWith(title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                Else
                    If String.Equals(candidate, title, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then Return arr
                End If
            Next
            Return Nothing
        End Function

            Dim gs As Multivariate.DiscriminantGroupStatistics = Nothing

Public Shared Function BuildNamedMatrixOutput(idHeader As String, rowNames() As String, colNames() As String,
                                               mat(,) As Double, includeHeader As Boolean) As UdfReportProjection38
            If mat Is Nothing Then Return UdfReportProjection38.FromFault(UdfReportFault38.NotAvailable)

            Dim n As Integer = mat.GetLength(0)
            Dim p As Integer = mat.GetLength(1)
            Dim out(n - 1 + If(includeHeader, 1, 0), p) As Object
            Dim r0 As Integer = 0

            If includeHeader Then
                out(0, 0) = idHeader
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(0, j + 1) = If(colNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso j < colNames.Length, colNames(j), (j + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                Next
                r0 = 1
            End If

            For i As Integer = 0 To n - 1
                out(r0 + i, 0) = If(rowNames IsNot Nothing AndAlso i < rowNames.Length, rowNames(i), (i + 1).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture))
                For j As Integer = 0 To p - 1
                    out(r0 + i, j + 1) = mat(i, j)
                Next
            Next

            Return New UdfReportProjection38(New Global.BESHStatNG.ResultTableOutputModel(out), UdfReportPreparation38.NormalizeBlanks)
        End Function
